description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of responses across two levels of ambiguity – “Outer” and “Inner” – categorized by whether participants were “Deceived,” “Partially” deceived, or “Not Deceived.” The chart contains six slices representing these combinations. The “Outer” ambiguity level shows a large, maroon slice labeled “Deceived” at approximately 67.6%, followed by a yellow slice for “Partially” at 57.9%, and a smaller, olive green slice for “Not Deceived” at 10.5%. The “Inner” ambiguity level displays a maroon “Deceived” slice at 31.6%, a yellow “Partially” slice at 23.5%, and a small olive green “Not Deceived” slice at 8.8%. A legend is present, associating colors with each response category and ambiguity level. Percentage labels are included directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered by decreasing size within each ambiguity level.
